headline: Deutsche Bank shares decline following leak of internal records
summary: Shares of Deutsche Bank fell after a leak involving millions of documents emerged, putting the German lender's historical transactions under scrutiny.
why: Deutsche Bank is Germany's largest lender and a global systemically important financial institution; document leaks can trigger regulatory probes and litigation expenses.

impacts.name: Deutsche Bank
impacts.why: A leak of millions of documents prompted immediate selling in Deutsche Bank shares.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The emergence of leaked documents detailing historical activity triggered investor concern and selling in the stock.
